faq: What can I stick them on?
Journals, scrapbooks, planners, letters and cards are perfect. They also work on laptops and notebooks.
There’s a wide mix of quotes, poems, hearts and vintage art. You can see every design in the “every design in the pack” photo above.
Between about 4 and 7 cm. Sizes vary by design, so some are little word strips and some are larger notes.
Do they suit a bright journal?
They’re designed for calm, neutral pages. If you love bright colours, the Motivational Quote stickers might suit you better.
What if I’m not happy with them?
You buy through Amazon, so Amazon’s usual returns process applies. You can also email me at hello@mazomoon.com and I’ll do what I can to help.
